summary: Tested viability-heatmap backend endpoint + ViabilityHeatmapSection inside Lousa Relatório popover. Backend: 8/8 pytests PASSED (default 30d, structure shape, demo districts present, parametrized days 7/30/90, auth required, days clamping). UI: confirmed section renders inside popover BELOW 'Visualizar Finalizadas' button (generate_btn y=1284 < section y=1338), title '🗺️ Demanda sem cobertura' visible, 3 range buttons (viab-range-7/30/90) all present and visible, viab-list rendered with 3 district items (Recreio 3, Jacarepagua 2, Olaria 1) matching backend data, gradient pink→purple bar visible, '6 lead(s) esperando expansão em 3 bairro(s)' caption shown, range toggle works (7d and 90d both reload and render 3 items in demo data). Sidebar entry is labeled 'Chamados' (route view='lousa') as per App.js line 166.

minor.issue: days=0 falls back to 30 due to `int(days or 30)` short-circuit instead of being clamped to 1 — minor (negative/zero values unusual).

action_items: (Optional) Pre-existing console errors: 4× 'Failed to load resource: 500' on initial page load (NOT from heatmap endpoint, observed during pre-Lousa navigation/dashboard load — likely from unrelated dashboard charts/widgets). Recommend main agent grep recent backend logs for 500s if dashboard widgets matter.
critical_code_review_comments: viability-heatmap endpoint correctly aggregates by district with phone-fallback via parse_address on first inbound message. Sort desc by leads, top 10 returned (UI consumes top 5). Good.

ViabilityHeatmapSection: graceful empty state (viab-empty) wired to total_pending===0 with friendly PT-BR copy; loading state separates fetch from render. Component is self-contained inside the popover with marginTop:14 + border-top dashed — matches design spec.

Possible UX nit: viab-district-* test IDs use raw district name lowercased. If a district contains accents (e.g., 'Jacarepaguá' with á), the testid would carry the accent. The seed/demo strips accents already, but worth normalizing district.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-') for robustness.
Backend `days = max(1, min(int(days or 30), 365))`: the `or 30` short-circuits when days=0, so the clamp to 1 never triggers for 0 (minor — see backend_issues.minor).
test_credentials: admin@empresa.com / 123456 (administrador) — works for the gestor-protected endpoint via require_role('gestor').
seed_data_creation: None — relied on existing demo data (6 leads in 3 districts: Recreio 3, Jacarepagua 2, Olaria 1) seeded earlier.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lousa is labeled 'Chamados' in sidebar (App.js:166). Login admin@empresa.com/123456 → click 'Chamados' → in Lousa header click data-testid=lousa-pdf-btn → popover opens at top-right → scroll to see ViabilityHeatmapSection below 'Visualizar Finalizadas' button. Backend demo data lives under company_id='co-demo' in db.viability_requests with phones whose first inbound message has Recreio/Jacarepagua/Olaria addresses.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as specified. The minor 'days=0 → 30 fallback' is intentional Python `or` semantics; not blocking.
